content.shloka:
Pralaya Payōdhi Jalē Dhṛtavān Asi Vēdam
Vihita Vahitra Charitram Akhedam
Kēśava Dhṛta Mīna Śarīra Jaya Jagadīśa Harē
content.meaning: In the waters of the great deluge, You held the Vedas. You enacted the play of the boat (ark) tirelessly. O Keshava, who assumed the form of a fish — victory to You, Lord of the universe, Hari!
content.transliteration:
Pralaya Payōdhi Jalē Dhṛtavān Asi Vēdam
Vihita Vahitra Caritram Akhedam
Kēśava Dhṛta Mīna Śarīra Jaya Jagadīśa Harē

content.shloka:
Om Matsya Rūpāya Vidmahē
Jalēśvarāya Dhīmahi
Tanno Viṣṇuḥ Prachodayāt
content.meaning: Om, we meditate upon the Fish form. We contemplate the Lord of the waters. May Lord Vishnu inspire us.
content.transliteration:
Oṁ Matsya Rūpāya Vidmahē
Jalēśvarāya Dhīmahi
Tanno Viṣṇuḥ Pracodayāt

content.shloka:
Satyavrata Rāja Kṛpāṁ Vidhāya
Matsya Rūpeṇa Jalaṁ Pravēśya
Vēdān Samuddhṛtya Dadau Vidhātrē
Śrī Matsya Dēvāya Namaḥ Sadā Mē
content.meaning: By bestowing grace upon King Satyavrata, entering the waters in the form of a fish, and rescuing the Vedas to give back to Brahma — my eternal salutations to Lord Matsya.
content.transliteration:
Satyavrata Rāja Kṛpāṁ Vidhāya
Matsya Rūpeṇa Jalaṁ Pravēśya
Vēdān Samuddhṛtya Dadau Vidhātrē
Śrī Matsya Dēvāya Namaḥ Sadā Mē

content.shloka:
Śaṅkha Cakra Gadā Padma Dhāriṇam
Mīna Rūpa Dharaṁ Bhagavantam
Saptarṣi Naukā Parirakṣakam
Matsya Avatāraṁ Praṇamāmi Nityam
content.meaning: Bearer of conch, disc, mace, and lotus, the Lord who assumed the fish form, protector of the boat of the seven sages — I bow eternally to the Matsya Avatar.
content.transliteration:
Śaṅkha Cakra Gadā Padma Dhāriṇam
Mīna Rūpa Dharaṁ Bhagavantam
Saptarṣi Naukā Parirakṣakam
Matsya Avatāraṁ Praṇamāmi Nityam

content.shloka:
Kṣitir Iha Vipalē Babhūva Ena
Daśavatāra Kṛtē Kṛtē
Kēśava Dhṛta Kacchapa Rūpa Jaya Jagadīśa Harē
content.meaning: When the earth was imperiled, through each of the ten incarnations — O Keshava, who assumed the tortoise form, victory to You, Lord of the universe!
content.transliteration:
Kṣitir Iha Vipalē Babhūva Ena
Daśavatāra Kṛtē Kṛtē
Kēśava Dhṛta Kacchapa Rūpa Jaya Jagadīśa Harē

content.shloka:
Mandara Girim Anēna Nidhāya Pṛṣṭhe
Kṣīra Sāgara Madhyē Sthitam Acyutam
Samudra Manthanam Kurma Avatāram
Praṇamāmi Anantam Amṛta Dātāram
content.meaning: Placing Mount Mandara on His back, Achyuta who stood in the midst of the Milk Ocean, the Kurma Avatar of the ocean churning — I bow to the infinite one, the giver of nectar.
content.transliteration:
Mandara Girim Anēna Nidhāya Pṛṣṭhē
Kṣīra Sāgara Madhyē Sthitam Acyutam
Samudra Manthanam Kūrma Avatāram
Praṇamāmi Anantam Amṛta Dātāram

content.shloka:
Om Kūrmāya Namaḥ
Amṛta Samudra Manthanē Ādhāra Bhūtāya
Viṣṇavē Parabrahmāṇē Namaḥ
content.meaning: Om, salutations to Kurma. To the one who became the foundation during the churning of the ocean of nectar — salutations to Vishnu, the supreme Brahman.
content.transliteration:
Oṁ Kūrmāya Namaḥ
Amṛta Samudra Manthanē Ādhāra Bhūtāya
Viṣṇavē Parabrahmāṇē Namaḥ

content.shloka:
Dēvāsura Samāgamē Kūrma Rūpadharaḥ Prabhuḥ
Ratna Caturdasaṁ Dātuṁ Jagatāṁ Hitakāmyayā
content.meaning: In the assembly of gods and demons, the Lord assumed the Kurma form, desiring the welfare of the worlds by bestowing the fourteen jewels.
content.transliteration:
Dēvāsura Samāgamē Kūrma Rūpadharaḥ Prabhuḥ
Ratna Caturdaśaṁ Dātuṁ Jagatāṁ Hitakāmyayā

content.shloka:
Vasati Daśana Śikhare Dharaṇī Tava Lagnā
Śaśini Kalaṅka Kalēva Nimagnā
Kēśava Dhṛta Śūkara Rūpa Jaya Jagadīśa Harē
content.meaning: The earth rests on the tip of Your tusk, looking like a spot on the moon. O Keshava, who assumed the boar form — victory to You, Lord of the universe!
content.transliteration:
Vasati Daśana Śikhare Dharaṇī Tava Lagnā
Śaśini Kalaṅka Kalēva Nimagnā
Kēśava Dhṛta Śūkara Rūpa Jaya Jagadīśa Harē

content.shloka:
Hiraṇyākṣam Nihatya Mahābalam
Bhūmiṁ Samuddhṛtya Rasātalāt
Varāha Mūrtiṁ Paramēśvaram
Praṇamāmi Lokēśvaram Acyutam
content.meaning: Having slain the mighty Hiranyaksha, lifting the Earth from the netherworld, the Varaha form of the Supreme Lord — I bow to the Lord of the worlds, Achyuta.
content.transliteration:
Hiraṇyākṣam Nihatya Mahābalam
Bhūmiṁ Samuddhṛtya Rasātalāt
Varāha Mūrtiṁ Paramēśvaram
Praṇamāmi Lokēśvaram Acyutam

content.shloka:
Om Namaḥ Śrī Varāhāya
Bhūmi Uddhāraṇa Kāraṇāya
Hiraṇyākṣa Vināśāya Namaḥ
content.meaning: Om, salutations to Sri Varaha, the cause of the Earth's rescue, the destroyer of Hiranyaksha.
content.transliteration:
Oṁ Namaḥ Śrī Varāhāya
Bhūmi Uddhāraṇa Kāraṇāya
Hiraṇyākṣa Vināśāya Namaḥ

content.shloka:
Dharaṇīṁ Gadāṁ Cakraṁ Śaṅkhaṁ Cha Bibhrat
Daṁṣṭrā Agrē Dharāṁ Dhārayan Bhagavān
Ādi Varāhaḥ Paripālayēt Naḥ
content.meaning: Bearing the Earth, the mace, the disc, and the conch, holding the Earth on the tip of His tusk — may the primeval Varaha protect us.
content.transliteration:
Dharaṇīṁ Gadāṁ Cakraṁ Śaṅkhaṁ Ca Bibhrat
Daṁṣṭrā Agrē Dharāṁ Dhārayan Bhagavān
Ādi Varāhaḥ Paripālayēt Naḥ

content.shloka:
Tava Kara Kamala Varē Nakham Adbhuta Śṛṅgam
Dalita Hiraṇyakaśipu Tanu Bhṛṅgam
Kēśava Dhṛta Narahari Rūpa Jaya Jagadīśa Harē
content.meaning: On Your beautiful lotus hands, the nails are wondrous weapons that tore apart the body of Hiranyakashipu like a wasp. O Keshava, who assumed the Man-Lion form — victory to You!
content.transliteration:
Tava Kara Kamala Varē Nakham Adbhuta Śṛṅgam
Dalita Hiraṇyakaśipu Tanu Bhṛṅgam
Kēśava Dhṛta Narahari Rūpa Jaya Jagadīśa Harē

content.shloka:
Stambhāt Āvirbhūtō Bhagavān Nṛsiṁhaḥ
Prahlāda Varadō Daityēśa Nāśanaḥ
Sandhyā Samayē Na Dinaṁ Na Rātriḥ
Ugrō'pi Bhaktānāṁ Suśāntarūpaḥ
content.meaning: The Lord Narasimha manifested from the pillar, boon-giver to Prahlada, destroyer of the demon king. At twilight — neither day nor night — though fierce, He is gentle to His devotees.
content.transliteration:
Stambhāt Āvirbhūtō Bhagavān Nṛsiṁhaḥ
Prahlāda Varadō Daityēśa Nāśanaḥ
Sandhyā Samayē Na Dinaṁ Na Rātriḥ
Ugrō'pi Bhaktānāṁ Suśāntarūpaḥ

content.shloka:
Ugram Vīraṁ Mahāviṣṇuṁ Jvalantaṁ Sarvatomukham
Nṛsiṁhaṁ Bhīṣaṇaṁ Bhadraṁ Mṛtyur Mṛtyuṁ Namāmyaham
content.meaning: I bow to the fierce, heroic, all-pervading Maha Vishnu, blazing in all directions — Narasimha, the terrifying yet auspicious one, the death of Death itself.
content.transliteration:
Ugram Vīraṁ Mahāviṣṇuṁ Jvalantaṁ Sarvatōmukham
Nṛsiṁhaṁ Bhīṣaṇaṁ Bhadraṁ Mṛtyur Mṛtyuṁ Namāmyaham

content.shloka:
Om Namaḥ Śrī Nṛsiṁhāya
Prahlāda Rakṣakāya Namaḥ
Hiraṇyakaśipu Hantré Namaḥ
content.meaning: Om, salutations to Sri Narasimha, protector of Prahlada, slayer of Hiranyakashipu.
content.transliteration:
Oṁ Namaḥ Śrī Nṛsiṁhāya
Prahlāda Rakṣakāya Namaḥ
Hiraṇyakaśipu Hantrē Namaḥ

content.shloka:
Chalayasi Vikramaṇē Balim Adbhuta Vāmana
Pada Nakha Nīra Janita Jana Pāvana
Kēśava Dhṛta Vāmana Rūpa Jaya Jagadīśa Harē
content.meaning: O wondrous Vamana, You deceived Bali with Your strides. The water born from Your toenail (the Ganga) purifies all people. O Keshava, who assumed the Dwarf form — victory!
content.transliteration:
Calayasi Vikramaṇē Balim Adbhuta Vāmana
Pada Nakha Nīra Janita Jana Pāvana
Kēśava Dhṛta Vāmana Rūpa Jaya Jagadīśa Harē

content.shloka:
Tribhuvana Māpayitvā Dvi Padābhyāṁ
Bali Rājyaṁ Harannadhirōhya Viṣṇuḥ
Trivikramō Bhagavān Vāmanākhyaḥ
Sarvēśvaraṁ Praṇamāmi Anantam
content.meaning: Measuring the three worlds in two steps, seizing Bali's kingdom, Lord Vishnu known as Trivikrama Vamana — I bow to the infinite Lord of all.
content.transliteration:
Tribhuvana Māpayitvā Dvi Padābhyāṁ
Bali Rājyaṁ Harannadhirōhya Viṣṇuḥ
Trivikramō Bhagavān Vāmanākhyaḥ
Sarvēśvaraṁ Praṇamāmi Anantam

content.shloka:
Om Vāmanāya Namaḥ
Trivikramāya Namaḥ
Upēndra Rūpāya Viṣṇavē Namaḥ
content.meaning: Om, salutations to Vamana, to Trivikrama, to the form of Upendra — salutations to Vishnu.
content.transliteration:
Oṁ Vāmanāya Namaḥ
Trivikramāya Namaḥ
Upēndra Rūpāya Viṣṇavē Namaḥ

content.shloka:
Ādityā Garbha Sambhūtaṁ Kaśyapasya Mahātmanaḥ
Vāmanam Adbhutaṁ Vandē Viṣṇōḥ Padaṁ Paraṁ Sadā
content.meaning: Born from the womb of Aditi and the great soul Kashyapa, I worship the wondrous Vamana — the supreme abode of Vishnu, always.
content.transliteration:
Ādityā Garbha Sambhūtaṁ Kaśyapasya Mahātmanaḥ
Vāmanam Adbhutaṁ Vandē Viṣṇōḥ Padaṁ Paraṁ Sadā

content.shloka:
Kṣatriya Rudhira Mayē Jagadapagata Pāpam
Snapayasi Payasi Śamita Bhava Tāpam
Kēśava Dhṛta Bhṛgupati Rūpa Jaya Jagadīśa Harē
content.meaning: With the blood of warriors You washed the world free of sin, bathing it and relieving worldly suffering. O Keshava, who assumed the form of Bhrigu's lord — victory!
content.transliteration:
Kṣatriya Rudhira Mayē Jagadapagata Pāpam
Snapayasi Payasi Śamita Bhava Tāpam
Kēśava Dhṛta Bhṛgupati Rūpa Jaya Jagadīśa Harē

content.shloka:
Jamadagni Sutaṁ Vīraṁ Paraśudharam Acyutam
Kārtavīrya Vināśāya Praṇamāmi Bhṛguvarṣabham
content.meaning: Son of Jamadagni, the heroic one bearing the axe, Achyuta — for the destruction of Kartavirya, I bow to the bull of the Bhrigu clan.
content.transliteration:
Jamadagni Sutaṁ Vīraṁ Paraśudharam Acyutam
Kārtavīrya Vināśāya Praṇamāmi Bhṛguvarṣabham

content.shloka:
Om Paraśurāmāya Namaḥ
Bhṛgunandanāya Viṣṇavē
Dharma Saṁsthāpanāya Namaḥ
content.meaning: Om, salutations to Parashurama, son of Bhrigu, Vishnu incarnate — salutations to the establisher of Dharma.
content.transliteration:
Oṁ Paraśurāmāya Namaḥ
Bhṛgunandanāya Viṣṇavē
Dharma Saṁsthāpanāya Namaḥ

content.shloka:
Ēkaviṁśati Vāraṁ Pṛthivīṁ Kṛtvā Niḥkṣatriyāṁ
Samantapañcakē Dattavān Bhūmiṁ Kaśyapāya Mahīm
content.meaning: Having made the earth devoid of Kshatriyas twenty-one times, at Samantapanchaka he gave the earth to Kashyapa.
content.transliteration:
Ēkaviṁśati Vāraṁ Pṛthivīṁ Kṛtvā Niḥkṣatriyāṁ
Samantapañcakē Dattavān Bhūmiṁ Kaśyapāya Mahīm

content.shloka:
Vitarasi Dikṣu Raṇē Dik Pati Kamanīyam
Daśamukha Mauli Baliṁ Ramaṇīyam
Kēśava Dhṛta Rāma Śarīra Jaya Jagadīśa Harē
content.meaning: You scattered in battle the beautiful heads of the ten-faced one as offerings to the guardians of directions. O Keshava, who assumed the body of Rama — victory!
content.transliteration:
Vitarasi Dikṣu Raṇē Dik Pati Kamanīyam
Daśamukha Mauli Baliṁ Ramaṇīyam
Kēśava Dhṛta Rāma Śarīra Jaya Jagadīśa Harē

content.shloka:
Rāmaṁ Daśarathiṁ Viddhi Mām Viṣṇuṁ Sanātanam
Sītā Lakṣmīr Na Sandehaḥ Dharma Saṁsthāpanāya Cha
content.meaning: Know Rama, son of Dasharatha, as Me — the eternal Vishnu. Sita is verily Lakshmi, without doubt, and this incarnation is for the establishment of Dharma.
content.transliteration:
Rāmaṁ Daśarathiṁ Viddhi Mām Viṣṇuṁ Sanātanam
Sītā Lakṣmīr Na Sandēhaḥ Dharma Saṁsthāpanāya Ca

content.shloka:
Śrī Rāma Rāma Rāmēti Rasē Jihvē Sadā Mama
Āpadāṁ Apahartāraṁ Dātāraṁ Sarvasampādāṁ
content.meaning: Sri Rama, Rama, Rama — may this be always on the tip of my tongue. He who removes all adversities and bestows all prosperity.
content.transliteration:
Śrī Rāma Rāma Rāmēti Rasē Jihvē Sadā Mama
Āpadāṁ Apahartāraṁ Dātāraṁ Sarvasampadām

content.shloka:
Maryādā Puruṣottamaṁ Raghukula Tilakam
Rāvaṇāntakam Sētubandha Rachayitāram
Śrī Rāmachandraṁ Praṇamāmi Satatam
content.meaning: The supreme person of propriety, the ornament of the Raghu dynasty, slayer of Ravana, builder of the bridge — I eternally bow to Sri Ramachandra.
content.transliteration:
Maryādā Puruṣōttamaṁ Raghukula Tilakam
Rāvaṇāntakam Sētubandha Racayitāram
Śrī Rāmacandraṁ Praṇamāmi Satatam

content.shloka:
Kṛṣṇāya Vāsudēvāya Harayē Paramātmanē
Praṇata Klēśa Nāśāya Gōvindāya Namō Namaḥ
content.meaning: Salutations to Krishna, son of Vasudeva, to Hari the Supreme Self, the destroyer of the sorrows of those who surrender — salutations again and again to Govinda!
content.transliteration:
Kṛṣṇāya Vāsudēvāya Harayē Paramātmanē
Praṇata Klēśa Nāśāya Gōvindāya Namō Namaḥ

content.shloka:
Vasudēva Sutaṁ Dēvaṁ Kaṁsa Chāṇūra Mardanam
Dēvakī Paramānandaṁ Kṛṣṇaṁ Vandē Jagadgurum
content.meaning: I worship Krishna, son of Vasudeva, destroyer of Kamsa and Chanura, the supreme bliss of Devaki, the Guru of the universe.
content.transliteration:
Vasudēva Sutaṁ Dēvaṁ Kaṁsa Cāṇūra Mardanam
Dēvakī Paramānandaṁ Kṛṣṇaṁ Vandē Jagadgurum

content.shloka:
Yadā Yadā Hi Dharmasya Glānir Bhavati Bhārata
Abhyutthānam Adharmasya Tadātmānaṁ Sṛjāmyaham
content.meaning: Whenever there is decline of Dharma and rise of Adharma, O Bharata, then I manifest Myself.
content.transliteration:
Yadā Yadā Hi Dharmasya Glānir Bhavati Bhārata
Abhyutthānam Adharmasya Tadātmānaṁ Sṛjāmyaham

content.shloka:
Kṛṣṇaṁ Vandē Jagadguruṁ Gōvindaṁ Gōpī Vallabham
Murali Manoharaṁ Dēvaṁ Nanda Gōpa Kumārakam
content.meaning: I worship Krishna, the world-teacher, Govinda, beloved of the Gopis, the enchanting flute-player, the divine son of cowherd Nanda.
content.transliteration:
Kṛṣṇaṁ Vandē Jagadguruṁ Gōvindaṁ Gōpī Vallabham
Muralī Manōharaṁ Dēvaṁ Nanda Gōpa Kumārakam

content.shloka:
Nindasi Yajña Vidhēr Aha Ha Śruti Jātam
Sadaya Hṛdaya Darśita Paśu Ghātam
Kēśava Dhṛta Buddha Śarīra Jaya Jagadīśa Harē
content.meaning: You condemn the ritual of sacrifice born from the Vedas, O compassionate-hearted one, showing the cruelty of animal killing. O Keshava, who assumed the form of Buddha — victory!
content.transliteration:
Nindasi Yajña Vidhēr Aha Ha Śruti Jātam
Sadaya Hṛdaya Darśita Paśu Ghātam
Kēśava Dhṛta Buddha Śarīra Jaya Jagadīśa Harē

content.shloka:
Ahiṁsā Paramo Dharmaḥ Sarva Prāṇi Hitē Rataḥ
Buddha Rūpiṇaṁ Viṣṇuṁ Vandē Karuṇā Sāgaram
content.meaning: Non-violence is the supreme Dharma, devoted to the welfare of all beings. I worship Vishnu in the form of Buddha, the ocean of compassion.
content.transliteration:
Ahiṁsā Paramō Dharmaḥ Sarva Prāṇi Hitē Rataḥ
Buddha Rūpiṇaṁ Viṣṇuṁ Vandē Karuṇā Sāgaram

content.shloka:
Om Buddhāya Namaḥ
Karuṇā Mūrtayē Namaḥ
Viṣṇōḥ Avatārāya Namaḥ
content.meaning: Om, salutations to Buddha. Salutations to the embodiment of compassion. Salutations to the Avatar of Vishnu.
content.transliteration:
Oṁ Buddhāya Namaḥ
Karuṇā Mūrtayē Namaḥ
Viṣṇōḥ Avatārāya Namaḥ

content.shloka:
Sarva Bhūta Dayāvantaṁ Śāntaṁ Samadarśinam
Dharma Cakra Pravartakam Buddhaṁ Praṇamāmyaham
content.meaning: Compassionate to all beings, peaceful, seeing all equally, the turner of the Wheel of Dharma — I bow to Buddha.
content.transliteration:
Sarva Bhūta Dayāvantaṁ Śāntaṁ Samadarśinam
Dharma Cakra Pravartakam Buddhaṁ Praṇamāmyaham

content.shloka:
Mlēccha Nivaha Nidhane Kalayasi Karavālam
Dhūma Kētuṁ Iva Kim Api Karālam
Kēśava Dhṛta Kalki Śarīra Jaya Jagadīśa Harē
content.meaning: For the destruction of the hordes of barbarians, You wield the sword, terrible like a comet. O Keshava, who assumes the body of Kalki — victory to the Lord of the universe!
content.transliteration:
Mlēccha Nivaha Nidhane Kalayasi Karavālam
Dhūma Kētuṁ Iva Kim Api Karālam
Kēśava Dhṛta Kalki Śarīra Jaya Jagadīśa Harē

content.shloka:
Kaliyuga Ante Sambhaviṣyati Bhagavān
Śvēta Aśva Ārūḍhaḥ Khaḍga Dhārī
Viṣṇuyaśā Grāme Sambhala Nāmni
Dharma Saṁsthāpanaṁ Kariṣyati Kalkī
content.meaning: At the end of Kali Yuga, the Lord shall manifest, mounted on a white horse, bearing a sword, in a village named Shambhala, son of Vishnuyasha — Kalki shall re-establish Dharma.
content.transliteration:
Kaliyuga Ante Sambhaviṣyati Bhagavān
Śvēta Aśva Ārūḍhaḥ Khaḍga Dhārī
Viṣṇuyaśā Grāme Śambhala Nāmni
Dharma Saṁsthāpanaṁ Kariṣyati Kalkī

content.shloka:
Om Kalkine Namaḥ
Dharma Yuddha Pravartakāya
Kaliyuga Antakāya Viṣṇavē Namaḥ
content.meaning: Om, salutations to Kalki, the initiator of the war of Dharma, the ender of Kali Yuga — salutations to Vishnu.
content.transliteration:
Oṁ Kalkinē Namaḥ
Dharma Yuddha Pravartakāya
Kaliyuga Antakāya Viṣṇavē Namaḥ

content.shloka:
Satya Yugasya Ādi Kartā Kalki Bhagavān
Adharma Vināśāya Dharma Rakṣāya Cha
Viṣṇōḥ Daśamō Avatāraḥ Kalkiḥ
Namāmi Taṁ Bhāvi Yugāvatāram
content.meaning: Kalki, the Lord who inaugurates the Satya Yuga, for the destruction of Adharma and protection of Dharma — Vishnu's tenth Avatar, Kalki. I bow to that future incarnation of the age.
content.transliteration:
Satya Yugasya Ādi Kartā Kalki Bhagavān
Adharma Vināśāya Dharma Rakṣāya Ca
Viṣṇōḥ Daśamō Avatāraḥ Kalkiḥ
Namāmi Taṁ Bhāvi Yugāvatāram
